mods.name: Silencers For All Weapons
mods.summary: Built-in suppressors for every gun that could never have one.
mods.description: Metal suppressors with real suppressed sound and no muzzle flash, including the Hidden Arsenal weapons. Still experimental.

mods.name: Instant Interaction
mods.summary: Hold-to-interact actions become quick taps.
mods.description: Turns hold-to-interact actions, including crafting and dialogues, into taps and skips unnecessary interaction animations.

mods.name: No Camp Bike Speed Limit
mods.summary: Ride through camps without the bike speed cap.
mods.description: Keeps normal engine upgrade speeds. It overrides a shared slowdown, so scripted bike scenes may also be affected.

mods.name: No Item Glow
mods.summary: Removes the glow on pickups.
mods.description: Keeps prompts and mission clues.

mods.name: Fixed 150 Health and No Injectors
mods.summary: Health stays at 150 maximum.
mods.description: The Health upgrade choice is removed. Physical injectors and Stamina and Focus upgrades remain.

mods.name: Manual Weapon Holstering
mods.summary: No idle auto holstering; F6 holsters manually.
mods.description: Story actions can still holster weapons.

mods.name: Weapons In Encampments
mods.summary: Use weapons inside camps.
mods.description: Bypasses the camp weapon restriction; NPC protection remains.

mods.name: Brighter Bike Customization
mods.summary: A brighter mechanic camera.
mods.description: Less blur and no dark vignette while customizing the bike.

mods.name: Lasting Survival Vision
mods.summary: Survival vision outlines stay on after you let go.
mods.description: Anything survival vision outlines stays outlined after you let go: loot, crates, weapons, mission objects and other interactables. Things that load in later glow after your next scan; tracking clues still fade as usual. It replaces the player controller, so only one mod that changes the player controller applies.

mods.name: Brighter Loot Shimmer
mods.summary: A brighter, warmer shimmer on pickups.
mods.description: Optional extra from the Lasting Survival Vision download. Loot stands out without scanning. It replaces the pickup blueprint, so it does not work together with Instant Interaction or No Item Glow.

mods.name: More Normal Freakers 3x
mods.summary: More freakers, mild.
mods.description: Freakers roam day and night, take the spawn slots deer, wolves and marauders used to get and show up in groups. Works on existing saves; removing it gives spawn areas their old numbers back. Pick only one tier. The tiers contain the population maps, so they override other mods that edit them.

mods.name: More Normal Freakers 5x
mods.summary: More freakers, medium.
mods.description: Freakers roam day and night, take the spawn slots deer, wolves and marauders used to get and show up in groups. Works on existing saves; removing it gives spawn areas their old numbers back. Pick only one tier. The tiers contain the population maps, so they override other mods that edit them.

mods.name: More Normal Freakers 10x
mods.summary: More freakers, heavy; nests spawn freakers too.
mods.description: Freakers roam day and night, take the spawn slots deer, wolves and marauders used to get and show up in groups. Works on existing saves; removing it gives spawn areas their old numbers back. Pick only one tier. The tiers contain the population maps, so they override other mods that edit them.

mods.name: More Normal Freakers 20x
mods.summary: More freakers, very heavy.
mods.description: Freakers roam day and night, take the spawn slots deer, wolves and marauders used to get and show up in groups. Works on existing saves; removing it gives spawn areas their old numbers back. Pick only one tier. The tiers contain the population maps, so they override other mods that edit them.

mods.name: More Normal Freakers Crazy
mods.summary: As many freakers as the game will take; costs performance.
mods.description: Freakers roam day and night, take the spawn slots deer, wolves and marauders used to get and show up in groups. Works on existing saves; removing it gives spawn areas their old numbers back. Pick only one tier. The tiers contain the population maps, so they override other mods that edit them.

mods.name: Bigger Hordes
mods.summary: Most open world hordes are twice as big.
mods.description: Optional extra from the More Normal Freakers download, alone or next to any tier. The Highway 97 and 150 hordes grow a bit less, the two 300 hordes stay as they are. Works on existing saves; hordes you already cleared stay cleared.

mods.name: More Specials
mods.summary: More special freakers out at once, and back sooner.
mods.description: Optional extra from the More Normal Freakers download. More breakers, screamers, reachers, newts, bleachers, rager bears and freaker wolves; they still unlock with the story.

mods.name: Days Gone First Person (Beta)
mods.summary: An experimental first-person view for Days Gone.
mods.description: The published beta is still in development. Its exact release package has not been matched to a verified local file, so this manager cannot safely identify or install it yet.
mods.unsupportedReason: The exact published beta has not been audited. Download it from Nexus for a local package review; local development candidates are different builds.

mods.name: Unbreakable Silencers
mods.summary: Keep supported silencers from wearing out.
mods.description: Removes silencer wear on weapons that accept them, including the covered Hidden Arsenal weapons. It does not add silencer support to weapons that normally lack it.

mods.name: XP Randomizer
mods.summary: Add a random boost to earned XP rewards.
mods.description: Makes XP payouts less predictable across combat, missions and other reward sources. Smaller boosts are more common than large payouts. This is a separate package from No Recoil.

mods.name: No Recoil
mods.summary: Remove recoil, shot spread, firing bloom and aim sway.
mods.description: Keeps crosshairs steady across stock ranged weapon types, including pistols, shotguns, crossbows and flamethrowers. Normal firing, ammunition use, damage and projectile or pellet counts are preserved. Install XP Randomizer separately if wanted.

mods.name: Manual Bike Headlight
mods.summary: Choose when your bike's headlight stays on.
mods.description: Use the normal light control, F by default, to operate the headlight yourself. Getting on or off the bike no longer changes the light automatically.

mods.name: Deacon Size Shifter
mods.summary: Change Deacon's size with the arrow keys.
mods.description: Up and Down step through ten sizes from 0.25x to 2.5x. Larger sizes change damage and grab behavior; the smallest sizes also change how enemies notice Deacon.

mods.name: Teleport To Map Marker
mods.summary: Travel to the map cursor with T.
mods.description: Open the world map, position the cursor at your destination and press T. This restores the game's built-in map teleport control.

mods.name: No Mission Distance Limit
mods.summary: Remove mission failures caused by wandering too far away.
mods.description: Lets you leave a companion, target or mission area without the usual distance-failure rule. Mission objectives and scripted progress still need to be completed normally.

mods.name: No Enemy Detection Toggle
mods.summary: Toggle enemy detection with Ctrl+P.
mods.description: Switch detection off when you want enemies, freakers and hordes to ignore you, then press Ctrl+P again to restore it.

mods.name: Noclip Toggle
mods.summary: Fly through the world with Ctrl+Backspace.
mods.description: Get off your bike before turning noclip on. Use WASD to move, Space to rise and Left Ctrl to descend. Ctrl+Backspace returns to ordinary movement.

mods.name: Noclip And No Enemy Detection Toggle
mods.summary: Noclip and enemy-detection switches in one package.
mods.description: Press Ctrl+Backspace for noclip and Ctrl+P to switch enemy detection. Get off the bike before using noclip. Use this published combined package instead of the separate toggles or No Enemy Detection; their shared player-controller assets cannot work together by load order.

mods.name: Unrestricted Mission Movement
mods.summary: Lift scripted walking and mission bike speed restrictions.
mods.description: Restores freer movement in companion walk-and-talk sections and removes covered mission bike speed and nitrous restrictions. It also includes the current camp speed change. Shared mission maps can conflict with other mission edits.

mods.name: Longer Days 2x (2 Hour Day)
mods.summary: Make a complete day and night last two real hours.
mods.description: Slows daytime and nighttime equally. Sleep and missions can still advance or set the clock. Choose one Longer Days option at a time.

mods.name: Longer Days 4x (4 Hour Day)
mods.summary: Make a complete day and night last four real hours.
mods.description: Slows daytime and nighttime equally. Sleep and missions can still advance or set the clock. Choose one Longer Days option at a time.

mods.name: Longer Days 8x (8 Hour Day)
mods.summary: Make a complete day and night last eight real hours.
mods.description: Slows daytime and nighttime equally. Sleep and missions can still advance or set the clock. Choose one Longer Days option at a time.

mods.name: Longer Days Real Time (24 Hour Day)
mods.summary: Let the normal world clock run in real time.
mods.description: One minute outside the game equals one minute on the ordinary world clock. Sleep and missions can still move time forward. Choose one Longer Days option at a time.
mods.source: release/longer-days/Longer Days Real Time (24 hour day).zip

mods.name: Infinite Bike Fuel And No Bike Crash Ejection
mods.summary: Keep your bike fueled and stay on through crashes.
mods.description: This published package combines infinite bike fuel with no crash ejection. Use it instead of the separate fuel and crash-ejection packages, since they replace the same player asset. Other mods changing that asset can still conflict.
mods.source: release/bike-fuel-no-ejection-merge/Infinite Bike Fuel and No Bike Crash Ejection.zip

mods.name: Longer Lasting Melee Weapons
mods.summary: Make melee weapons last three times longer.
mods.description: Reduces wear so melee weapons survive more hits before breaking. Choose this or Unbreakable Meele Weapons; they replace shared melee assets.

mods.name: One Hit Boot Knife
mods.summary: Kill regular freakers with one boot-knife hit.
mods.description: Changes boot-knife damage against regular freakers across difficulty settings. This description does not promise a one-hit kill against every enemy type.

mods.name: Hidden Arsenal
mods.summary: Bring hidden and world-only weapons into camp lockers.
mods.description: Adds normally unavailable weapons and variants to the camp locker with purchasing and ammunition-refill support. Other weapon overhauls may replace the same assets; check the conflict report before enabling them together.

mods.name: Infinite Ammo With Reload
mods.summary: Keep reserve ammunition while reloading normally.
mods.description: Magazines still run down, so reload timing remains part of combat. Choose this or Infinite Ammo No Reload. Shared weapon assets can also conflict with other weapon mods.

mods.name: Infinite Ammo No Reload
mods.summary: Fire without emptying magazines or reserve ammunition.
mods.description: Removes ammunition depletion and the need to reload. Choose this or Infinite Ammo With Reload. Other mods editing the same weapon files cannot be combined by load order.

mods.name: No Enemy Detection
mods.summary: Keep enemies from noticing Deacon.
mods.description: Disables normal enemy detection while installed. For a keyboard switch, use No Enemy Detection Toggle instead. Both options have their own conflict checks.

mods.name: Free Bike Repair
mods.summary: Repair the bike without spending scrap.
mods.description: Removes the scrap cost of repairing Deacon's bike. It shares the repair interaction asset with mods that alter the same action, so those changes may conflict.

mods.name: Free Crafting
mods.summary: Craft items without spending materials.
mods.description: Removes crafting-material requirements and consumption from the covered crafting menu. It can overlap with other mods that change that menu or its transactions.

mods.name: Infinite Bike Fuel
mods.summary: Ride without draining the bike's fuel tank.
mods.description: Stops ordinary fuel consumption while riding. It replaces a shared player asset, which is also used by several health, detection and bike-behavior mods.

mods.name: Infinite Nitro
mods.summary: Use the bike's nitro without draining it.
mods.description: Keeps the nitro supply available for repeated use. Mission scripts may impose their own movement restrictions.

mods.name: Perfect Bike Aim
mods.summary: Steady sidearm aiming while riding.
mods.description: Changes covered sidearm aiming settings used on the bike. It may share weapon assets with ammunition and accuracy mods; a different filename does not resolve an overlap.

mods.name: No Bike Crash Ejection
mods.summary: Stay on the bike through crashes and heavy impacts.
mods.description: Prevents the normal crash knock-off behavior. It replaces a shared player asset and therefore conflicts with other packages editing that asset.

mods.name: Unbreakable Meele Weapons
mods.summary: Keep melee weapons from breaking through use.
mods.description: Removes normal melee durability loss. Choose this or Longer Lasting Melee Weapons, since both replace shared melee assets.

mods.name: Unrestricted Fast Travel
mods.summary: Relax the ordinary restrictions on fast travel.
mods.description: Removes covered fast-travel restrictions while retaining destination and transition checks. Map-menu and world-map changes can conflict with other travel or teleport mods.

mods.name: Infinite Stamina
mods.summary: Run and dodge without draining stamina.
mods.description: Stops the covered stamina drain behavior. Difficulty and balance mods may use the same stamina assets.

mods.name: Infinite Weapon Focus
mods.summary: Keep Focus available without exhausting its meter.
mods.description: Removes the normal Focus drain. Other mods that change Focus behavior can overlap with its asset.

mods.name: Infinite Health
mods.summary: Prevent Deacon from losing health.
mods.description: Changes the shared player asset to prevent normal health loss. The local standalone PAK is audited; its original release ZIP is not present in this workspace.

mods.name: No Environmental Bike Damage
mods.summary: Stop environmental impacts from damaging the bike.
mods.description: Removes covered environmental collision damage. It does not promise protection from every scripted event or enemy attack.

mods.name: Unforgiving Difficulty
mods.summary: The UNFORGIVING difficulty in the Hard slot.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Damage taken: melee 3x, animals 2.5x, gunfire 3.25x. Damage dealt 0.9x, ammo pickups 0.3x, bike fuel use 1.5x, XP 0.75x. Other difficulties stay vanilla. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Rolling Costs Stamina
mods.summary: Every dodge roll costs 15 stamina.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Melee Swings Cost Stamina
mods.summary: Melee swings cost stamina, hit or miss.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Swings cost 15 stamina, heavy swings 30. Recovery pauses after a swing and Deacon cannot swing on an empty bar. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Faster Stamina Drain
mods.summary: Sprinting drains stamina 30% faster; it recharges 20% slower.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Does not work next to Faster Focus Drain (same game file). For both, use Faster Stamina And Focus Drain on its own. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Faster Focus Drain
mods.summary: Focus drains a third faster and recharges 30% slower.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Does not work next to Faster Stamina Drain (same game file). For both, use Faster Stamina And Focus Drain on its own. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Faster Stamina And Focus Drain
mods.summary: Faster Stamina Drain and Faster Focus Drain in one file.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Use it on its own instead of the two single files. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Weaker NERO Injectors
mods.summary: NERO injectors give +20 instead of +25.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Health, stamina and focus cap at 300 instead of 350. Does not work next to Tougher Enemies (same game file); use Tougher Enemies Weaker Injectors for both. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Tougher Enemies
mods.summary: Freakers have 20% more health, Ragers and wolves 15% more.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Does not work next to Weaker NERO Injectors (same game file); use Tougher Enemies Weaker Injectors for both. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Tougher Enemies Weaker Injectors
mods.summary: Tougher Enemies and Weaker NERO Injectors in one file.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Use it on its own instead of the two single files. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Tougher Night Swarmers
mods.summary: Swarmers have 30% more health after dark.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Sharper Enemy Senses
mods.summary: Enemies see and hear 20% further and lock on faster.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Freakers, Newts, Breakers, Screamers, Reachers and humans. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Hordes Notice Sooner
mods.summary: A horde notices you from 20 m instead of 15.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Bigger Freaker Packs
mods.summary: Roaming freaker packs are about 50% larger.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Named hordes are untouched. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Humans Aim Better
mods.summary: Humans reach full accuracy a third sooner when you stand in the open.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Tougher Armor Plates
mods.summary: Armor plates on Marauders, Militia and Rippers take 50% more punishment.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Weaker Healing
mods.summary: Bandages and medkits heal 20 to 25% less.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Herbal cocktails are unchanged. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Fewer Crafted Bolts
mods.summary: Crafting bolts gives 3 instead of 5, special bolts 2 instead of 3.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Cheaper Freaker Ears
mods.summary: Freaker ears sell for 3 credits instead of 5.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Melee Weapons Wear Faster
mods.summary: Melee weapons wear out twice as fast.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Double Scrap Bike Repair
mods.summary: Bike repair needs twice the scrap.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. The Monkey Wrench skill still halves it. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Bike Crashes Hurt More
mods.summary: Impact and landing damage to the bike is 30 to 40% higher.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Unforgiving: Gas Cans Fill Less
mods.summary: Gas cans refuel slower and stop at 80% of a bike tank.
mods.description: One piece of the Unforgiving Hardcore Difficulty Overhaul, from the Unforgiving Standalone download. Pumps and NERO generators still fill up. Pieces that change the same game file cancel each other; the toolkit shows those as conflicts.

mods.name: Skill Respec
mods.summary: Reset purchased skills and refund their skill points.
mods.description: On the skills overview, hold Ctrl and press the normal Confirm action twice to respec. Make a save backup before changing a character build.

mods.name: Art The Clown (Player Model)
mods.summary: Art the Clown replaces Deacon throughout the game.
mods.description: A full character appearance replacement with the split suit, painted grin, tiny top hat and white fingerless gloves. The bundled picture is an author model preview, not a live game render.

mods.name: Bleed Out
mods.summary: Organ hits and bleeding for human enemies and Freakers. ASI plugin; manual setup.
mods.description: Brain, heart and central throat hits kill immediately. Other vital hits can cause bleeding, stagger and limping. This release is a native ASI plugin with a separate loader, not a PAK.
mods.unsupportedReason: Manual ASI setup is required. Follow the Nexus instructions with Days Gone closed. The toolkit does not install, enable, disable or remove native plugins.
mods.compatibilityNotes: PAK conflict scans, profiles and Find the bad mod do not inspect or switch off ASI plugins. No listed PAK overlap does not mean this plugin is compatible. Do not use this published release together with Headshot Only Freakers.
requires: The supported Steam game build and the supplied x64 ASI loader, or an existing compatible loader.
On Linux, follow the plugin and Proton instructions; native Linux support is not implied.
notes: Open Setup on Nexus for the published file instructions. The Field guide has a separate ASI loader chapter.
The toolkit cannot tell whether this plugin is installed or running.
Do not run this published release together with Headshot Only Freakers.
Installed ASI and DLL plugins stay active across PAK profiles. Switching a profile or disabling a toolkit PAK does not switch them off.

mods.name: Ragdoll Deaths
mods.summary: Humans and nearby Freakers drop into ragdolls after direct gun or crossbow kills.
mods.description: Replaces ranged death animations for humans, regular Freakers, nearby horde members, Screamers and Bleachers. Distant horde members keep their normal animation system. Deacon, Newts, animals, melee, explosions, fire and poison clouds stay unchanged.
notes: Some scripted actions can still play their original death animation.
Other packages replacing NPCPawnDyingAnim or SwarmerPawnDyingAnim will be reported as PAK conflicts.

mods.name: Bike Wheelie
mods.summary: Hold Left Shift while riding to lift the front wheel; hold Left Ctrl to lower it.
mods.description: Keyboard wheelie controls for Deacon’s bike. Works above walking speed with the rear wheel on the ground; camps, cutscenes, water and airborne riding keep their usual controls. Crashes, damage and fuel stay unchanged.
notes: Other mods replacing BillsBike, such as Manual Bike Headlight, can conflict. Choose one or review a supported combination in Workshop.

mods.name: Headshot Only Freakers
mods.summary: Regular Freakers need ranged headshots. Optional distant-horde ASI support is installed separately.
mods.description: The managed PAK changes regular Freakers and nearby horde members: direct gun and crossbow head hits kill, while body hits do no meaningful damage. Specials, humans, melee, explosives and fire keep their normal rules.
requires: Import only HeadshotOnlyFreakers_P.pak through the toolkit.
The optional Horde support folder contains an ASI plugin and loader for distant horde members; follow its manual instructions and supported Steam-build requirement.
notes: The toolkit manages only the PAK. It does not install, toggle or remove the optional ASI plugin or its loader.
Without the optional plugin, distant horde members can still die from body shots.
Poison, fire and explosive bolt effects can still cause damage after a body hit.
PAK profiles and conflict scans do not cover the optional native plugin. Do not use it together with the published Bleed Out release.
See Field guide → ASI loaders for Windows and Proton setup guidance.
An installed horde ASI stays active across PAK profiles. Disabling this PAK in the toolkit does not switch off the separate plugin.
